description: This file defines a DatabaseHelper class for managing a local notes database in an Android application. It handles creation and upgrade logic for an SQLite database, specifically managing a 'notes' table with columns for id, title, content, created_at, and updated_at.

classes.name: DatabaseHelper
classes.description: A helper class extending SQLiteOpenHelper to manage database creation and version management for notes.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Creates the notes table in the database when the database is first created.

methods.name: onUpgrade
methods.description: Handles database schema upgrades by dropping existing table and recreating it.
